data.name: Souryam
data.gender_notes: Souryam is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Surya, the Hindu god of the sun. The name Souryam carries the meaning “Sun Worshipper” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Souryam usually hope their child will grow to embody sun worshipper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents light, energy, and life force.
data.etymology: Souryam belongs to the Sanskrit, Hindi, etc. linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun Worshipper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Souryam total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Souryam carries a rich cultural heritage in Hinduism. It derives from the Sanskrit word "Surya," which is the name of the Hindu god of the sun. This celestial deity holds immense significance in Hindu cosmology, underlining life-giving energy, vitality, power, and illumination. Numerous hymns, mantras, and rituals to Surya attest to his role as a harbinger of light, good health, and happiness within Hindu households and throughout Hinduism's vast narrative tapestry.
data.spiritual_significance: The moniker Souryam signifies a deeper spiritual connection to Surya's essence and divinity. Individuals who bear this name can draw inspiration from the god's unwavering, brilliant, and life-giving qualities as a matchless spiritual guide. As the sun symbolizes strength, leadership, prosperity, and an optimistic outlook, those named Souryam may find themselves invested with these spiritually uplifting attributes. Ultimately, embracing the spiritual significance of Souryam implies aligning oneself with the light, warmth, and invigorating power swirling within Surya's divine circle.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Souryam: Embodiment of the Sun God, radiant and all-pervading, bringing warmth and light to life's journey.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Souryam is a name mentioned in the Mahabharata, an ancient Indian epic. The name Souryam carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Souryam is the name of a king in the epic.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Souryam remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.
